mutations.name: the removed exemption is dropped
kills: a PR that only deletes old-path files, or renames them out of the root, touches nothing frozen; a rename into the root does

mutations.name: any superseded-at value is accepted, including an exited milestone
mutations.find:
if (exited.has(target)) stale ??= tag;
    else return { tag };
kills: superseded-at naming an exited milestone is a stale carve-out and refuses

mutations.name: the freeze is keyed on M1a instead of M1b
kills: a PR touching products/factory/src/shepherd whose task has no carve-out tag is refused once M1b has exited
before M1b exits an untagged touch is recorded as advisory and does not refuse

mutations.name: an unread milestones.json reads as inactive
kills: an unread milestones.json reads the freeze as active

mutations.name: the root matches without the trailing slash
kills: agent-chat src outside burndown is not frozen, and products/factory/src/shepherd-x is not under the shepherd root
